// OUR EDITORIAL POLICY

We understand that there are many websites on the internet making one medical claim or another and that it can be difficult to trust what you read. 

Here at Kiierr, we are committed to providing the best possible quality information regarding hair loss and subsequent treatments. 

We have a rigorous standard for truth. That is why we are sharing some insights about our editorial policy with you; we want you to know that all the information you read on our site has gone through a thorough vetting process. 

We understand what an impact hair loss can have on a person’s confidence and we are dedicated to providing a community where people can find genuine solutions for their hair loss in order to improve their lives. 

The Kiierr community is open to men and women of all ages, races, and nationalities. Whether you have ample hair loss, minimal hair loss, or no hair loss yet, you are welcome here! 

 

// MISSION

Our mission is to help as many people as possible with hair loss to regrow their hair in order to boost their self-image, and to help them live happier, more confident lives. We do this by providing as much key scientific and medical information about hair loss as we can. 

 

// HOW WE CREATE CONTENT

We have a high-quality team of writers and subject matter experts who produce our content using the latest scientific information. All of our information is based on medical research from universities, government organizations, or private entities led by medical experts. The content that we provide is designed to help you take actionable steps to reverse your hair loss. 

 

// HOW WE SELECT OUR WRITERS

Our writers undergo a thorough vetting process to make sure that they have the skill and the expertise that is needed to be able to write exceptionally high-quality content that is accurate and based on the latest medical findings in hair loss treatment. Our writers are experts at sourcing and research. 

 

// OUR SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTS

  • Theodore J. Daly, MD, FAAD, FSPD, FASD

Dr. Theodore J. Daly is a triple-board certified dermatologist who has been in practice for 38 years. He is a graduate of Jefferson Medical School. He completed his internship at Harvard Medical School at Brigham and Woman’s and Woman’s Hospital. His dermatology and fellowship training was completed at the University of Colorado School of Health Sciences. 

  • Amy McKinlay PA-C, MPAS

Amy McKinlay is a graduate of Idaho State University. She graduated with a Master’s in Physician’s Assistant Studies. She has extensive experience in minimally invasive cosmetic dermatology and has a passion for skin and hair loss. 

  • Mike Mosk – Clinical Laser Wavelength Expert

Mike Mosk is a laser technology professional with fifty years of experience in the medical industry. He is also the president of Pentech Inc. and Sounds. He has vast experience with medical lasers of every clinical application and wavelength. He holds a patent for medical lasers that stimulate collagen production. He co-invented this device with the Mayo Clinic Foundation. 

  • Dr. Kristin Grote, DC

Dr. Kristin Grote is a certified Doctor of Chiropractic. She has a passion for natural therapies and treatments that stimulate the body’s own natural healing mechanisms. She aims to help as many people as possible to live healthy, fulfilling lives. 

  • Dr. Prem Tripathi, MD, MPH 

Dr. Prem is a facial plastic and reconstructive surgeon who practices in the San Francisco Bay area.  He attended a number of prestigious schools and universities including the Keck School of Medicine at the University of Southern California. During his schooling, he earned 10 merit-based scholarships and was inducted into the Alpha Omega Honor Society, which is only given to the top 10 percent of medical students in the country. 

  • Raymond Blanche – Laser Cap Clinical Expert

Raymond is one of the pioneers of the laser cap industry. Not only did he help invent the LLLT device, but he also has conducted several clinical studies to determine the safety and effectiveness of LLLT on people with alopecia. He is one of the leading experts in low-level light therapy. 

Visit our medical advisors page here.

 

// HOW WE REVIEW CONTENT

All of the content that goes on the Kiierr website is reviewed and fact-checked by our subject matter experts. They make sure that the writers have included only the best possible information and cited all of the proper sources. 

The content only makes it to the website if our subject matter experts are happy with it and believe that it provides ample benefit to our audience while also being scientifically and medically accurate. 

We take our content review process extremely seriously and make sure that we only provide our readers with top-quality content. 

 

// REFERENCES

When we are evaluating a source for citation, we focus on the following factors: date published, objectivity, and authoritativeness. 

We rely on the following types of sources for our information: 

  • Government agencies 
  • Peer-reviewed studies 
  • Academic institutions 
  • Medical associations 

 

// THE LATEST SCIENCE

We periodically review all of our content to make sure that it is accurate and in line with the latest science. The hair loss industry is an industry that is always developing. Breakthroughs are regularly made and our writers and subject matter experts stay on top of all of the latest information. 

We routinely provide updates in our content for things like: 

  • Breakthrough studies and research 
  • Updated clinical guidelines 
  • Reader and/or user feedback 
  • Drug approvals and/or recalls 

We work hard to make sure that the information we publish is as up-to-date as possible and contains all the latest science and does not contain any contradictions or errors. We also listen to the feedback of our readers and address concerns. If you have any concerns with any of our content, feel free to reach out to us and we will address them. 

 

// AFFILIATE ADS AND LINKS

We do not display affiliate ads or links on the Kiierr website. This helps us to maintain the highest levels of integrity, authenticity, and security. 

 

// STYLE AND VOICE

Our tone is professional, informative, welcoming, and sincere. We care deeply about each and every single one of our readers and we want nothing more than to be able to help all of them to reach their hair growth goals. 

We believe that hair loss is a problem that can be solved and we strive every day to help people get the solutions that they need. We also try to make sure that all of our tone is extremely easy to read. We try to explain medical concepts and research as simply as well can so that everyone can easily understand the important information. 

 

// FEEDBACK POLICY

If you have any feedback you would like to provide us, feel free to do so here. We are very interested in your perspective and listen to reader and customer feedback very carefully. Once we receive your feedback on our content or our products, we will carefully review it and then respond to it as the situation demands. We thank you in advance for your feedback.
